title: Uruguayan Empanada Crust with Chinese Aromatic Filling
description: A twist on traditional empanadas with a crispy crust and a flavorful Chinese-inspired filling.

ingredients.name: Aromatic Chinese Filling
ingredients.notes: Combine with 1/4 cup chopped scallions and 1/4 cup chopped cilantro

ingredients.name: Scored Beef
ingredients.notes: Slice into thin strips, score with a sharp knife

ingredients.name: Empanada Filling (optional)
ingredients.notes: Add 1/4 cup diced vegetables (e.g., carrots, bell peppers)

instructions: Roll out Uruguayan Empanada Dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a spoonful of Aromatic Chinese Filling in the center of each dough circle.
Add a few slices of Scored Beef on top of the filling.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-circle shape and press edges together to seal.
Brush tops with Fat (Vegetable Oil) and sprinkle with Crispy Fried Onions.
Bake in preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm, garnished with additional chopped scallions and cilantro if desired.
